notes: When a new version is out, the app now tells you as it opens, with Update now and Skip. Stock has three buttons: All stock, Available stock and Expired. History, Customers, Suppliers and Expenses can be shown as a list or as cards. Home names who To Collect and To Pay are made of, and a recent bill shows one figure: Due in red or Paid in green. Expenses opens with the total, and the form opens from an Add expense button. A new item on a bill appears at the top. Fixed: a bill marked Full no longer leaves a few paise due when it is rounded off afterwards, and an expiry typed with a one-digit month no longer comes out wrong. Colours are calmer: green and white, with soft warnings.
